constraints.text: Effects (contribute, book, save-pick) run only after a click on a toll booth. Amounts, slots, and picks come from user input or pack data, never from LLM text.
Every stretch, including deterministic fallback stretches and injected demo stretches, passes the same compiler with the active pack invariants before it renders.
The LLM never writes facts. Claim text renders only from the active pack facts table or from tool result rows, by ID. Every LLM label passes the grounded-text guard.
Every compiler invariant has at least one fixture that the compiler rejects, and `npm run lab -- fixtures` exits 1 if any fixture result is wrong.
A 401, 402, or 403 from the model API stops all later model calls for the session. The road continues on the fallback paver.
The sun-life pack shows a crisis exit (call or text 9-8-8) on every stretch and never renders a clinical claim.
road-lab follows playground/AGENTS.md: self-contained prototype folder, design tokens only, tap targets of 44 px or more, works at 375 px, and `npm run check` passes.
Every model output passes the server checker before it becomes a visible node. After 3 failed attempts, the node becomes a fixed dead-end tile that offers a retry path.
The model never writes a number into a finance tile. The simulator gives every number. A message may contain only numbers that appear in the data of its own tile or in the user's own words.
Every user pick writes an answer row and one rule row for each rule, linked by foreign key. A changed pick marks the old answer superseded and keeps the old child as a not_taken node.

When a fork or this-or-that node appears, the server generates one child node for each option in the background. The pick promotes that child to taken. The other children stay in SQLite as not_taken nodes. Sliders and idea cards generate their child after the answer.
SQLite stores sessions, nodes (a tree through parent_id), answers, rules, generations (every model call with prompt, raw text, errors, and latency), and sim_runs.
The server calls Gemini through direct HTTP requests in a custom loop. No agent framework or harness is used.
A 401, 402, or 403 from the model API stops all later model calls in the server process. The road continues on fixed fallback tiles.
